selection_reason: APW-08 completed_verified in AIOC PR #455, closing the APW/APM/CSW design series. The final handoff identifies APW-I01 as the highest-leverage first application slice while CCTI-12-T04 remains owner-deferred until September 2026, WP-011 is special-environment dormant and DS-008 is blocked non-owner.
objective: Implement contextual account/role projection and Personal-context authority extensions on the existing Stage A identity/authorization architecture so one stable user subject can safely enter Personal, Campaign and Session contexts without permanent Player/GM account caste, global role bleed, hidden-information leakage or predecessor-contract replacement.

application_baseline.rule: Re-fetch current main and migration head before creating the implementation branch. If main changed, revalidate touchpoints and migration numbering before mutation.

primary_touchpoints: A3 dashboard/workspace discovery and projection contracts
Campaign/Session and A6 proposal/approval consumers that currently project active roles
completion_gate: A stable subject can hold different contextual roles across multiple Campaigns, use a useful Personal context with zero Campaign membership, switch Personal↔Campaign↔Session with fresh authorization and protected cache partitioning, retain unrelated entitlements/resources when a Campaign role changes, and pass additive compatibility/regression evidence without converting existing Stage A active-role projections into global account identity.
required_implementation_questions: What is the smallest additive contract versioning needed to express Personal/Campaign/Session context while preserving current A3 compatibility?
Which current consumers incorrectly assume singular activeRole means account identity, and what bounded adapters remove that assumption?
Can APW-I01 complete without a new migration; if persistence is required, what established owner holds it and what is the current next migration number at branch creation?
How will Personal context be represented without making it an authority super-domain?
How will WorkspaceSwitcher and DashboardPage expose context without trusting UI/route/query state as authority?
What cache/subscription/AI-context partitioning occurs on protected context transition?
Which fixtures prove zero-Campaign, multi-role multi-Campaign, role-revocation, Owner/Admin separation, entitlement separation and Live↔Async cadence invariance?
What exact Stage A regression matrix must pass before completion?
validation_policy: Focused deterministic checks during construction; exact-head application repository health; declared product/browser acceptance for affected UI; final tranche/platform gate follows the self-hosted Windows + self-hosted Linux + deterministic comparison policy where applicable.
next_action: Re-fetch Multiversal-app main and migration head, inspect the named APW-I01 touchpoints and current regression/validator surface, create the bounded APW-I01 application branch from exact current main, then implement the tranche before its declared final validation.
